acceptedAnswer.text: For window installation projects in Fort Worth, permits are typically required, especially if structural changes are involved or if the project alters the building's envelope. The specific requirements can vary based on the scope of work and local building codes. Obtaining proper permits ensures that installations meet safety standards and local regulations.
